page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 32-vCPU Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor built on x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance provides 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs included in the configuration.

Storage and networking architecture relies entirely on remote attachments. The instance includes no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 20 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio delivers balanced resource efficiency for standardized production workloads that require consistent processor performance without oversized memory footprints. The lack of bundled local disks necessitates planning for external storage latencies and network bandwidth allocation. The ecs.g9i.8xlarge is architecturally suited for distributed web applications, enterprise application servers, containerized microservices, build farms, and relational database servers running on remote storage volumes.
